name: Host Gal no Paraphilia
original_name: ホストガールの性倒錯(パラフィリア)
source:
A seemingly pure hearted gentleman abuses his wealth and influence to coerce host girls into training. At first the girls are miserable, but during training they melt with sensual pleasure...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE062312.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
一名看似心靈純潔的紳士濫用財富與影響力，脅迫陪酒女郎接受調教。女孩們起初痛苦不堪，卻在訓練中逐漸沉溺於肉慾的快感之中……
